items.title: Ramsey Lewis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: There was Dee Alexander, one vocalist. I took a page out of the book of Duke Ellington. She didn’t sing any lyrics.

ctx.x: There was Dee Alexander, one vocalist. I took a page out of the book of Duke Ellington. She didn’t sing any lyrics. Where I had her voice come in, either she made up her vowels or her lyrics or whatever she wanted to use to color this music.
Once again I’d be amiss if I did not tell you about the name of the conductor, because I can’t recall it now. Can we stop here, or what? Kimery: Sure.
